content: A common issue for many Natural Language Processing (NLP) classification tasks is class imbalance, the situation where one of the class categories comprises a significantly larger proportion of the dataset than the other classes. It is especially prominent in real-world datasets and complicates classification when the identification of the minority class is of specific importance.
